svg.aria-label: A sales rep asks an AI assistant "What’s the status on Acme?" The assistant reads the intent and makes an MCP tool call to CData Connect AI, the data gateway, which translates the intent and queries Salesforce with scoped credentials. Records come back to the gateway, structured data goes back to the assistant, and the assistant answers the rep. The rep’s access level is enforced, every access is logged, and the agent never sees raw schema.
svg.text: The rep’s access level is enforced
The agent never sees raw schema.
